items.assertion: CSV-sourced values written into a line-oriented log without neutralization

items.assertion: The grant macro falls back to the PUBLIC pseudo-role for any target it does not recognise

items.assertion: Certificate pinning is silently disabled on the failover retry path
items.class: improper certificate validation (CWE-295)

items.assertion: The attachment content provider is exported without permission and resolves paths from the caller's URI

items.assertion: The signature covers body only, and the unsigned type field is what selects the handler

items.assertion: The app binds all interfaces while the edge configuration documents it as loopback-only, and the whole identity model depends on that binding

items.assertion: The deep-link route name is validated against an allow-list while the navigation parameters beside it are passed through unchecked
items.class: Partial validation of external input / guard asymmetry (CWE-20)

items.assertion: Reconciliation overwrites balances from an unvalidated CSV, bypassing the overdraw guard entirely
items.class: Missing authorization and input validation on a privileged write path (CWE-20, CWE-862)

items.assertion: consume_batch builds Document directly from the queue message, bypassing every DocumentIn validator
items.class: Validation bypass on a parallel write path / index poisoning (AI-12, CWE-20)

items.assertion: Migration seeds a demo firm and principal into every environment, justified by a filter that does not exist
items.class: test fixture shipped in a production migration

items.assertion: The customer pseudonym is an unsalted digest keyed on a public version string
items.class: CWE-916 weak hash for a low-entropy input / reversible pseudonymisation

items.class: CWE-1188 API that implies a control it does not implement

items.assertion: No Unicode or hidden-content normalisation on the ingestion path; normalise promotes invisible markup text to prose

items.assertion: All five manifests use floating version ranges and no lockfile exists anywhere in the tree

items.assertion: Staging publishes the export bucket to the world while replicating production export objects into it

items.class: Sensitive data exposure / public object storage (CWE-668, CWE-552)

items.assertion: Statement fields reach a line-oriented log without neutralisation
items.class: Log injection (CWE-117)

items.assertion: Batch member array declares no size bound
items.class: uncontrolled resource consumption

items.assertion: Stored content type chosen by the uploader and echoed on download

items.assertion: The producer HMAC covers only the body field, leaving the type field that selects the handler unsigned

items.assertion: SQL injection sink in the posting handler: message-supplied currency is string-interpolated into the posting_tags INSERT while every other column is parameterised

items.assertion: PATCH narrows by org only while the list it mirrors narrows by crew, and no role gate exists on any route

items.assertion: Crew-to-site authorization table is a source literal whose comment claims it is loaded and refreshed nightly

items.assertion: The app ships a route table naming a legacy support-impersonation endpoint the file states the gateway still answers
items.class: Attack-surface disclosure / probable unauthenticated privileged route (CWE-1230, CWE-863)

items.assertion: Sort allowlist resolves inherited Object.prototype members, returning values it was meant to exclude
items.class: incomplete allowlist / failed validator

items.assertion: Exported CSVs carry unneutralized note text into spreadsheet formula context
items.class: CSV formula injection

items.assertion: redact_note authorizes against a case that is never tied to the note it modifies
items.class: confused deputy / object-level authorization on the wrong object

items.assertion: The per-plan seat and call limits are declared and never enforced; seatsRemaining has zero callers
items.class: Business logic / a declared limit nothing enforces (WEB-23)

items.assertion: rotate-secrets prints the live database password in clear through a debug task with no no_log

items.assertion: Partner analytics role can be assumed by any AWS principal, gated only on an external id

items.assertion: Task-role trust policies carry no source-account or source-ARN confused-deputy condition

items.assertion: The reports bucket public access block leaves the two policy-related flags disabled
items.class: CWE-668 incomplete public access block

items.assertion: Staging publishes the exports bucket to anonymous readers while replicating production objects into it
items.class: data-exposure

items.assertion: Service tokens fall back to a hard-coded signing key when SERVICE_TOKEN_KEY is unset

items.assertion: The incremental watermarks use strict inequality and drop rows that tie with the maximum

items.assertion: _verify_producer checks only that a signature field is present, never that it is valid, and the accepted document skips all schema validation

items.assertion: createLegacyArchive builds a fully public S3 bucket with every access guard disabled

items.assertion: Two aws.s3.BucketPolicy resources target the same bucket in staging, making the effective policy non-deterministic

items.assertion: The role starts the application twice, and the un-namespaced systemd copy reads LISTEN_ADDR=0.0.0.0 on hosts with no firewall

items.assertion: Exported CSVs embed note bodies unescaped, so a note beginning with = is a formula in the spreadsheet that opens it

items.assertion: The history array has no item schema, so a caller can inject a system turn that drives the tool loop
items.class: prompt injection through an unvalidated conversation role (CWE-20)

items.assertion: Nothing in the project expires anything

items.assertion: https intent filter declares no android:host, so any domain can deliver a link to the router

items.assertion: Every backing service is addressed over cleartext HTTP and the vector store client presents no credentials
